basis: Craniosynostosis and thoracic skeletal dysplasia define the syndrome; mechanical chest restriction alone does not establish direct lung damage.

decisions.pulmonary: none: direct pulmonary hypoplasia or injury is unestablished; asphyxiating chest restriction alone is insufficient. [Orphanet](https://www.orpha.net/en/disease/detail/100978)

basis: Cerebellar neurodevelopmental disease; ankle contractures in 5/5 assessed and multiple contractures in 3/3 support musculoskeletal involvement. Visual impairment is chiefly cerebral.

decisions.ocular: none: cerebral visual impairment is neurologic; abnormal ERG in one tested patient does not establish retinal damage in >=30% of the 18-patient cohort.

basis: Ocular, anorectal and cardiac malformations define CES; renal defects are frequent (30-79%). Frequent intellectual disability and skeletal anomalies omitted at cap; hearing impairment <30%.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: congenital cardiac malformations are an organ system explicitly included in the supplied disease definition and are frequent (30-79%); retained within the three-primary cap.

basis: Tumor arises in autonomic paraganglia; neuroendocrine histology alone does not establish endocrine gland disease. Ear occupation is subtype-specific.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: parasympathetic paraganglionic origin; typically no hormonal dysfunction or endocrine gland lesion. [GeneReviews](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK1548/)

basis: Blood/marrow B-cell neoplasm; infiltrative hepatomegaly is frequent (30-79%). Nephropathy and bone lesions are occasional (5-29%); proteinuria alone does not establish renal damage.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: a paraprotein-associated B-cell neoplasm; CLL/SLL resemblance does not itself establish lymphoma or immune disease. [WHO](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41375-022-01620-2)

basis: Severe intellectual disability and seizures define disease; precocious puberty in the sole reported patient (1/1) supports endocrine involvement, with uncertain generalizability.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: involved: precocious puberty in 1/1, also a characteristic in the clinical summary; provisional with one patient. [GTR](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gtr/conditions/C5677007/)

basis: Defining BWS features include macroglossia, hyperinsulinism, abdominal wall defects and lateralized overgrowth. Subtype frequencies are sparse; organ enlargement and tumor risks add no axes.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: lateralized skeletal/soft-tissue overgrowth and abdominal wall defects are cardinal BWS features. [Consensus](https://doi.org/10.1038/nrendo.2017.166)

basis: GM2 synthase deficiency is a ganglioside biosynthesis disorder causing spastic neuropathy; scoliosis 10/15 and pes cavus 9/17 support skeletal involvement. Cataracts and urinary findings <30%.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: demonstrated GM2 synthase deficiency disrupts ganglioside biosynthesis, an inborn metabolic defect. [Functional study](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9378512/)

basis: Blood/marrow leukemia; hepatic infiltration in most (~97%), cutaneous infiltration ~30-50%. Pulmonary infiltration causes respiratory failure in most untreated cases over the course.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: leukemic lung infiltration causes respiratory failure in most untreated patients (>30% over the course). [Cohort](https://www.elis.sk/download_file.php?product_id=6140)

basis: Nonsyndromic intellectual disability with motor delay; no disease-specific evidence establishes an inborn metabolic defect or endocrine dysfunction.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: none: broad carbohydrate-transport ancestry alone does not establish a metabolic disorder; supplied disease-specific features are exclusively neurodevelopmental.
